blocks.heading: Proof a Finance Interviewer Values
rows: A three-statement model for a listed company
Explain your assumptions and what changes the result most.
Shows modelling skill and reasoning.
A budget versus actual variance analysis
Say what the largest gap was and what you would do.
FP&A teams do this every month.
A short equity or credit note
Share the thesis, risks and what would change your mind.
Shows judgement and written communication.
Excel or Python analysis of public data
Describe the question and the finding.
Tool use with a question is more impressive than tool lists.
A paper portfolio log with reasons
Show decisions and mistakes honestly.
Reveals discipline, not luck.

blocks.heading: Weak Lines in a Finance Interview
rows: I want to earn a lot.
It focuses on you, not on the work.
Describe the decisions you want to help make.
I follow the stock market.
Too broad, and invites a tricky stock question.
Name a specific company or sector and a view with reasons.
Finance is the best field.
Sounds like a pitch and has no evidence.
Say what you like about it and what you have tried.
I am good at maths.
Finance needs judgement as well.
Give an example of a decision you made with numbers.

blocks.heading: Growth and AI Behind a Finance Answer
rows: Business analysis
Applies number sense to operations with a wide employer base.
Less direct exposure to markets.
Data analytics
Strong skill demand across sectors.
Requires coding and statistics.

blocks.heading: Practice Rounds Before the Interview
rows: Round 1: your story
Write your decision example.
A stranger can repeat your story back accurately after one hearing. Field check: numbers, choice and result are clear.
Round 2: delivery
Say it aloud in under a minute.
You finish in about a minute and it sounds like you, not a script.
Round 3: the hard question
Prepare a company valuation talk.
Your answer to the question you fear holds up without notes. Field check: you can state assumptions and ranges.
Round 4: full mock
Mock interview with the five follow-ups.
You keep the same facts when a follow-up changes the angle. Field check: steady on markets and AI.

figures.source: Keep spending on finance qualifications near 10 percent of your total education budget and treat 20 percent as a caution.
